Improved long menus such as `/permissions`, `/resume` and `/model` to say how many rows are above and below, and the `/` and `@` menus to count hidden rows outside fullscreen and screen reader mode
Improved list navigation: more lists wrap at both ends, checkbox lists in slash commands take Home and End, and `/permissions` says when a search finds nothing

title.zh-TW: 拉桿調整與各介面文字、間距細節改善
title.en: Slider Controls and Interface Wording and Spacing Improvements

body.zh-TW:
整理了 `/plugin`、`/mcp`、登入、設定、代理檢視、`/teleport`、Remote Control 與 `claude --help` 等處的介面文字。`/btw`、`/help` 與設定錯誤等對話框的對齊與間距也一起微調。

`/autocompact` 與 `/scroll-speed` 改用新版拉桿，能顯示每個數值、支援 `Home`、`End` 與全螢幕滑鼠點擊，也適合窄終端機。

`/config`、`/memory` 與 auto mode 設定裡的開關狀態，現在統一顯示為 `on` 與 `off`。
body.en:
Refined the wording across `/plugin`, `/mcp`, sign-in, settings, the agent view, `/teleport`, Remote Control, and `claude --help`. Alignment and spacing in dialogs such as `/btw`, `/help`, and settings errors were also adjusted.

`/autocompact` and `/scroll-speed` now use an updated slider that shows every value, supports `Home`, `End`, and mouse clicks in fullscreen, and fits narrow terminals.

Toggle states in `/config`, `/memory`, and auto mode settings now consistently read `on` and `off`.

items.original:
Improved wording across the terminal: `/plugin`, `/mcp`, sign-in, setup, settings, the agent view, `/teleport`, Remote Control, update messages, spinner tips, `/powerup` and `claude --help`
Improved `/autocompact` and `/scroll-speed` with a slider that shows every value, takes Home, End and (in fullscreen) clicks, and fits narrow terminals
Improved on/off settings to read `on` / `off` in `/config`, `/memory` and auto mode setup
Improved alignment and spacing in `/btw`, `/help`, `/scroll-speed`, the settings error dialog and dialogs that suggest a plugin or setting

title.zh-TW: 管線分頁按鍵、SSH 複製與全域設定套用修復
title.en: Fixes for Piped Pager Keys, SSH Copying, and Global Settings

body.zh-TW:
把 `claude --help` 導進分頁器（如 `claude --help | less`）閱讀時，方向鍵與 `q` 鍵現在能正常操作了。

透過 SSH 連線執行 `/copy` 與 `/export` 時，不再一律誤報已複製到剪貼簿。Pro 與 Max 用戶的對話分享詢問在發下一則訊息、`/clear` 或 `/resume` 後也會自動收起。

思考力度提示不再於每次權限對話後重跳，上下文警告也不再遮掉額度上限通知。`/config` 的減少動態效果與顯示提示改為全域套用，不再只影響目前資料夾。
body.en:
Arrow keys and `q` now work properly when `claude --help` is piped into a pager (such as `claude --help | less`).

Running `/copy` and `/export` over SSH no longer always claims the text was copied to the clipboard. The transcript share prompt for Pro and Max users also closes automatically after the next message, `/clear`, or `/resume`.

The effort level notice no longer reappears after every permission prompt, and the context warning no longer hides the usage limit notice. Reduce motion and Show tips in `/config` now apply globally instead of only to the current folder.

items.original:
Fixed the arrow keys and `q` not working in a pager that `claude --help` is piped to, as in `claude --help | less`
Fixed `/copy` and `/export` saying "copied to clipboard" over SSH when the terminal may not have copied anything
Fixed the transcript share question for Pro and Max users staying open after the next message, `/clear` or `/resume`
Fixed the effort level notice reappearing after every permission prompt or dialog, and the usage limit warning and other notices not appearing while the context warning showed
Fixed Reduce motion and Show tips in `/config` applying only to the current folder

title.zh-TW: claude logs 疊字與 /ide、/status 修復
title.en: Fixes for claude logs Overlap, /ide, and /status

body.zh-TW:
在非全螢幕模式下按下 `Ctrl+Z`，暫停訊息不再直接疊印在輸入框上面。執行 `claude logs` 時，輸出也不再蓋掉並混雜原本終端機裡的畫面。

在 `/ide` 出現`Connect to your IDE automatically?`問題時，按 `Esc` 現在能順利退出，不必連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 把整個程式關掉。

執行 `/status` 查看狀態時，安裝相關的警告訊息不再重複顯示兩次。
body.en:
Pressing `Ctrl+Z` outside fullscreen no longer prints the suspend message right over the prompt box. Running `claude logs` also no longer paints over and mixes with what was already in the terminal.

When `/ide` asks "Connect to your IDE automatically?", pressing `Esc` now exits cleanly instead of forcing you to press `Ctrl+C` twice and quit the entire app.

Running `/status` no longer shows installation warnings twice.

items.original:
Fixed the Ctrl+Z message printing over the prompt box outside fullscreen
Fixed `claude logs` painting over and mixing with what was already in the terminal
Fixed Esc not leaving the "Connect to your IDE automatically?" question in `/ide`, where Ctrl+C twice quit Claude Code
Fixed `/status` showing installation warnings twice

title.zh-TW: PR 狀態標章、折行網址點擊與筆記本編輯修復
title.en: Fixes for PR Status Badges, Wrapped URLs, and Notebook Edits

body.zh-TW:
切換分支後，頁尾 PR 標章不再停留上一支分支的內容；先跑 fetch 或 pull 後，「Pushed to」摘要也不會寫錯分支名。若 `gh` 拒絕執行且隱藏退出碼，畫面不再誤報「Merged PR」或「Closed PR」。

在不認得但支援連結的終端機裡，跨行折疊的網址以及 Rex 終端機裡的帶標籤連結現在都可以點擊了。

長單行訊息不再誤顯示「(0 lines hidden)」，會如實標示隱藏了多少文字。編輯筆記本漏寫類型或刪格時工具列不再不見，在最頂端插入儲存格也不會顯示 `@undefined`。
body.en:
After switching branches, the footer's PR badge no longer stays on the previous branch; after a fetch or pull, the "Pushed to" summary no longer names the wrong branch. When `gh` refuses the action and hides the exit code, the screen no longer falsely reports "Merged PR" or "Closed PR".

URLs that wrap across lines in unrecognized terminals with link support, as well as labeled links in the Rex terminal, are now clickable.

Long single-line messages no longer show "(0 lines hidden)" and instead accurately report how much text is hidden. Notebook edits no longer omit the tool row when a cell type is left out or a cell is deleted, and inserting a cell at the top no longer shows `@undefined`.

items.original:
Fixed the footer's PR badge showing the previous branch's pull request after switching branches
Fixed the "Pushed to" summary naming the fetched branch when a command fetched or pulled first, and "Merged PR" or "Closed PR" showing when `gh` refused the action and the exit code was hidden
Fixed URLs that wrap over several lines not being clickable in terminals with link support that Claude Code doesn't recognize, and labeled links in the Rex terminal
Fixed long single-line messages showing "(0 lines hidden)" instead of how much text is hidden
Fixed notebook edits showing no tool row when Claude left out the cell type or deleted a cell, and showing `@undefined` when inserting a cell at the top

title.zh-TW: VS Code 新增關閉下一句提問建議的設定
title.en: VS Code Adds Setting to Turn Off Prompt Suggestions

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 請 Claude 改程式時，如果覺得輸入框旁一直跳出「下一句可以問什麼」的提示有點干擾，現在多了一個專屬設定可以關掉它。

只要打開 VS Code 的 `settings.json`，加入下面這行就能關閉：

```json
{
  "claudeCode.promptSuggestions": false
}
```

⟦在紙上寫大綱時如果覺得旁邊有人不斷代擬下一句反而分心，只要把提醒紙條收起來就能安靜照自己步調寫。⟧
body.en:
When asking Claude to edit code in VS Code, if the prompt suggestions popping up beside the input box feel distracting, there is now a dedicated setting to turn them off.

Just open VS Code's `settings.json` and add this line to disable them:

```json
{
  "claudeCode.promptSuggestions": false
}
```

⟦If someone drafting the next line beside you while you outline on paper feels distracting, putting the reminder slips away lets you write quietly at your own pace.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added a `claudeCode.promptSuggestions` setting that turns prompt suggestions off

title.zh-TW: 修正 VS Code 分支對話倒回程式碼誤刪檔案
title.en: Fix VS Code Forked Conversation Rewind Deleting Files

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 分支對話點選「Rewind code to here」退回某一步時，過去偶爾會多倒退一輪並刪掉那一輪建好的檔案。這個問題已經修好，現在會準確停在你選定的那一輪。
body.en: When clicking "Rewind code to here" in a VS Code forked conversation, it previously occasionally undid one turn too many and deleted files created in that turn. This has been fixed so it now stops accurately at the turn you selected.

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed "Rewind code to here" in a forked conversation sometimes undoing one turn too many and deleting files created in that turn

title.zh-TW: VS Code 編輯加速與沙盒、記憶資料夾修復
title.en: VS Code Faster Edits and Sandbox and Memory Folder Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 關閉沙盒時，沙盒對話框不會再偷偷於家目錄與專案的 `.git` 資料夾建立空白檔案與資料夾。

記憶資料夾若有 symlink 迴圈，不再漏列項目或讓記憶體暴漲；遇到具名管線也不再卡死。指令執行中的即時輸出遇到一次讀取失敗後，不會再直接停擺。

如果編輯器原本就沒在未開啟分頁的檔案回報新問題，Edit 與 Write 現在不會再枯等問題檢查，改檔更快。
body.en:
When the sandbox is off in VS Code, the Sandbox dialog no longer silently creates empty files and folders in the home directory and the project's `.git` folder.

Symlink loops in the memory folder no longer cause missing items or runaway memory growth, and named pipes no longer cause a hang. A running command's live output also no longer stalls after a single failed read.

Edit and Write are now faster because they no longer wait idly for problem checks on files not open in a tab when the editor has not been reporting new problems for them.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Sandbox dialog creating empty files and folders in the home directory and the project's `.git` folder while the sandbox is off
[VSCode] Fixed saved memories not being listed in the Memory dialog, or RAM use growing without end, when the memory folder held symlink loops, and a hang when it held a named pipe
[VSCode] Fixed a running command's live output stopping after one failed read
[VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed: no wait for new problems on files that are not open in a tab when the editor has been reporting none for such files

title.zh-TW: VS Code 登入保存、貼碼提醒與額度按鈕修復
title.en: VS Code Sign-In Persistence, Code Paste Prompts, and Quota Button Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在部分網路環境下，VS Code 已儲存的登入狀態不再莫名遺失。使用 Console 主控台登入但沒有 API 金鑰時，每次打開面板或視窗也不再閃過一下登入畫面。

不小心貼進驗證碼、網址或其他登入嘗試的碼時，登入流程不會直接中斷，面板會改為告訴你應該貼上哪一種碼。

Team 與 Enterprise 成員在工作階段中重新登入後，用量上限橫幅上的「Request more」按鈕不會再每次按下去只跳回來卻什麼都沒送出。
body.en:
On some networks, VS Code's saved sign-in is no longer lost unexpectedly. When signed in to Console without an API key, the sign-in screen no longer flashes briefly each time a panel or window opens.

Pasting a verification code, web address, or code from another sign-in attempt no longer ends the sign-in flow; the panel now tells you what to paste instead.

After Team and Enterprise members sign in again during a session, the "Request more" button on the usage-limit banner no longer bounces back after each press without sending anything.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the saved sign-in being lost on some networks
[VSCode] Fixed sign-in ending when a verification code, a web address or a code from another sign-in attempt is pasted; the panel now says what to paste instead
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen showing briefly each time a panel or window opened while signed in to Console without an API key
[VSCode] Fixed the usage-limit banner's "Request more" button for Team and Enterprise members coming back after each press without sending anything, after you signed in again during a session

title.zh-TW: VS Code 的 /ide 切換、產出物連結與高對比修復
title.en: VS Code /ide Switching, Artifact Links, and High-Contrast Fixes

body.zh-TW:
第二個工作階段執行 `/ide` 時，不再默默被第一個搶走連線而斷開。現在會由最新的連線勝出，被替換掉的工作階段也會告訴你怎麼切回來。

在 bash、zsh、fish 與 Git Bash 用「Open in Terminal」卻啟動失敗時，現在會說明原因並附上安裝指南連結。發佈產出物後，面板也會顯示「Open artifact」連結。

對話面板失焦時，「attach selected text」提示不再被下一句建議蓋住；高對比主題的按鈕邊框與淺色高對比歡迎圖示也修好了。
body.en:
When a second session runs `/ide`, it no longer silently loses the connection back to the first session. The newest connection now wins, and the displaced session tells you how to switch back.

When "Open in Terminal" fails to start in bash, zsh, fish, or Git Bash, a notice now explains why and links to the install guide. After publishing an artifact, the panel also shows an "Open artifact" link.

While the chat panel is unfocused, the "attach selected text" hint is no longer hidden by the prompt suggestion; button borders in high-contrast themes and the welcome art in Light High Contrast are also fixed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed `/ide` in a second Claude Code session silently losing the editor connection back to the first session; the newest connection now wins and the displaced session shows how to switch back
[VSCode] Fixed "Open in Terminal" showing only the shell's error when `claude` could not be started: in bash, zsh, fish and Git Bash, a notice now explains why and links to the install guide
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing no "Open artifact" link after Claude publishes an artifact
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt suggestion hiding the "attach selected text" hint while the chat panel is unfocused
[VSCode] Fixed buttons with no visible border in the high-contrast themes, and the dark welcome art on the sign-in screen in Light High Contrast

title.zh-TW: VS Code 即時輸出樣式與擴充錯誤紀錄調整
title.en: VS Code Live Output Style and Extension Error Logging Updates

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 聊天面板執行指令時，即時輸出現在換成跟指令卡片「OUT」那一列一致的樣式，閱讀起來更統一。

給編輯器本身遙測收集參考的細節也做了調整：事件監聽、檢視與啟動階段發生的擴充功能錯誤文字，現在不會再混進編輯器自己的錯誤遙測裡。
body.en:
When running a command in the VS Code chat panel, the live output now matches the style of the command card's "OUT" row, making it more consistent to read.

Details for the editor's own telemetry collection have also been adjusted: extension error text from event listeners, views, and activation no longer mixes into the editor's own error telemetry.

items.original:
[VSCode] Changed a running command's live output in the chat to look like the command card's OUT row
[VSCode] Changed the text of extension errors in event listeners, views and activation to stay out of the editor's own error telemetry

title.zh-TW: 終端機工作區可開多個旁聊分頁
title.en: Terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs

body.zh-TW:
寫程式寫到一半想另開話題發問，不必擠在同一個對話框裡來回翻找。開啟選用性質的終端機工作區後，你可以在側邊同時建立多個旁聊分頁，直接用鍵盤或滑鼠在分頁間切換。

就算把 Codex 關掉重新啟動，之前留在本機的旁聊紀錄依然能再次打開接著用。⟦就像煮菜備料多擺幾個小碗，以前只能全倒進同一個碗裡混著攪，現在每道菜分開裝，隔餐打開冰箱還能原封不動端出來接著煮。⟧
body.en:
When you want to ask about a separate topic mid-coding, you no longer have to scroll back and forth inside a single chat box. With the opt-in terminal workspace enabled, you can open multiple side-chat tabs along the side and switch between them with your keyboard or mouse.

Even if you quit and restart Codex, you can still reopen saved local side chats and pick up where you left off. ⟦Picture prepping ingredients with several small bowls instead of dumping everything into one bowl to mix together: each dish stays separate, and when you open the fridge for the next meal, you can pull it out intact and keep cooking.⟧

items.original: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)

title.zh-TW: 代理指令中心可依關鍵字搜尋舊任務
title.en: Search older tasks by keyword in agent command center

body.zh-TW:
想找幾天前跑過的那個任務，不用再從清單一路往下慢慢滑。打開代理指令中心後，現在可以直接用任務名稱、提示詞預覽或工作目錄來搜尋較早的任務。

昨天剛處理完一份專案報告、今天想沿用當時的任務紀錄，只要輸入對應的工作目錄或提示詞裡的字句就能找出來。⟦跟去 KTV 點歌一樣，以前得一頁頁翻厚重的歌本找曲目，現在打歌名、歌詞片段或歌手名字就能立刻叫出來。⟧
body.en:
To find a task you ran a few days ago, you no longer have to scroll all the way down a long list. Inside the agent command center, you can now search older tasks by task name, prompt preview, or working directory.

If you finished a project report yesterday and want to reuse that task record today, just type the matching working directory or words from the prompt to pull it up. ⟦Think of picking songs at karaoke: instead of flipping page by page through a thick songbook, you type the title, a lyric snippet, or the artist's name to bring it right up.⟧

items.original: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕紀錄可收合過程只留回答
title.en: Collapse activity in full-screen transcript to keep answers

body.zh-TW:
回頭檢視長長的對話紀錄，最常被中間一大段工具執行過程洗版，想看最終回答得捲好久。現在只要在全螢幕對話紀錄開啟 **Collapse turn details**，每個提問底下已經完成的執行過程就會自動摺疊起來。

摺疊後回答本身依然清楚顯示在畫面上，而收起來的工具輸出內容也還是能直接搜尋。⟦好比逛展看畫作，以前連運送木箱和包裝紙都還堆在畫框底下，現在把打包材料收進儲藏室只留作品本身，真要查物流標籤依然調得到。⟧
body.en:
Reviewing a long transcript often means wading through walls of tool execution steps just to reach the final answer. Now, when you turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript, completed activity beneath each prompt folds away automatically.

Your answers stay clearly visible on screen, while the collapsed tool output remains directly searchable. ⟦A gallery exhibition works the same way: instead of leaving shipping crates and wrapping paper piled under every frame, the packing materials go into storage so only the artwork stays on display, yet you can still look up the shipping labels whenever needed.⟧

items.original: Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)

title.zh-TW: 終端機可管理自訂供應商並用裝置碼登入
title.en: Manage custom providers and sign in with device code in terminal

body.zh-TW:
連進遠端主機或沒有瀏覽器的純文字環境，想接入自訂的模型供應商常卡在無法跳轉網頁登入。現在你可以直接在終端機新增或修改自訂模型供應商。

只要啟用自訂閘道器引導設定，登入過程中就能順手建立供應商。遇到支援的閘道器，就算是在 SSH（遠端文字連線）或沒有本機瀏覽器的機器上，也能改用裝置碼完成驗證。⟦如同在沒有刷卡機的自助寄物櫃前，以前非得帶著實體感應卡才打得開，現在只要螢幕跳出一組取件碼，拿旁邊的手機輸入就能把櫃門連上打開。⟧
body.en:
Connecting to a remote host or a text-only environment without a browser often stalls when a custom model provider expects a web login redirect. You can now add or edit custom model providers directly from the terminal.

With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider right during sign-in. For supported gateways, even over SSH (remote text connection) or on a machine without a local browser, you can authenticate using a device code instead. ⟦Imagine standing at a self-service locker with no card reader: where you once needed a physical tap card, the screen now shows a pickup code that you enter on your phone beside it to open the door.⟧

items.original: Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)

title.zh-TW: 回報編輯器按 Ctrl+S 可本機存診斷檔
title.en: Press Ctrl+S in report editor to save diagnostics locally

body.zh-TW: 公司電腦限制網路或環境停用上傳功能，出狀況卻找不到地方把診斷資料帶出來給人排查。現在只要在終端機回報編輯器按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把診斷用 ZIP 壓縮檔直接存到本機，就算上傳功能被關閉也一樣能存。⟦彷彿在沒有手機訊號的山區寫工作日誌，以前送不出去就只能留在畫面上乾瞪眼，現在按一下存檔鍵就能先存進隨身記憶卡帶下山。⟧
body.en: When a corporate network is restricted or uploads are disabled, getting diagnostic data out for troubleshooting can be a dead end. Now, pressing `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor saves a diagnostic ZIP archive directly to your machine, even when uploads are turned off. ⟦It feels like writing a field log on a mountain with no cell signal: instead of staring at an unsent screen, you hit save to write it onto a portable memory card and carry it down with you.⟧

items.original: Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)

title.zh-TW: 終端機 Cloud 連線支援傳圖與封存對話
title.en: Terminal Cloud connection supports images and archiving

body.zh-TW:
用 macOS 或 Linux 開著終端機連上 Cloud，以前遇到要傳截圖或調整思考深度時，還是得另外找別的介面處理。現在啟用這項選用連線後，直接在終端機就能傳送圖片，也能挑選要用的模型和推理力度。

討論告一段落，或想還原 Cloud 對話時，在終端機同樣可以直接封存或還原 Cloud 對話。⟦比方說智慧手錶原本只能收到文字提醒，現在直接能在錶面上傳照片、調推播強度，還能把舊通知收起來或翻出來。⟧
body.en:
When connected to Cloud from a terminal on macOS or Linux, sending a screenshot or adjusting reasoning depth used to mean switching to another interface. With this opt-in connection enabled, you can now send images and choose your model and reasoning effort directly from the terminal.

Once a discussion wraps up, or when you want to bring back an earlier thread, you can archive or restore Cloud conversations right from the terminal as well. ⟦Say a smartwatch could previously only display text alerts, and now lets you send photos, adjust notification intensity, and tuck away or pull back old alerts straight from your wrist.⟧

items.original: With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

title.zh-TW: 未信任目錄執行 codex exec 不載入設定
title.en: codex exec skips project config in untrusted directories

body.zh-TW:
從網路下載陌生專案準備跑自動檢查，最怕資料夾裡夾帶的設定偷偷啟動外部連線。就算加上 `--sandbox workspace-write`，只要資料夾還沒被信任，`codex exec` 仍會把專案設定和 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器保持停用。

確認目錄安全、想正式儲存信任狀態，可在 `codex exec` 或 `codex review` 加上 `--trust` 參數。⟦拿電腦插上來路不明的隨身碟來說，就算你允許電腦寫入檔案，裡頭附帶的自動執行腳本還是會被鎖住，非得你親手點下信任按鈕才會放行並記住。⟧

```bash
codex exec --trust    # 執行任務並儲存專案信任
codex review --trust  # 進行審查並儲存專案信任
```
body.en:
Running automated checks on an unfamiliar project downloaded from the web always carries the risk of bundled settings silently opening external connections. Even with `--sandbox workspace-write`, `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers disabled as long as the directory is untrusted.

Once you verify the directory is safe and want to save its trusted status, pass `--trust` to `codex exec` or `codex review`. ⟦Plug an unfamiliar USB drive into your computer, and even if you allow writing files to it, its autorun scripts stay locked until you explicitly click trust to let them run and remember your choice.⟧

```bash
codex exec --trust    # Run task and save project trust
codex review --trust  # Run review and save project trust
```

items.original: `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)

title.zh-TW: 清空脈絡開始實作時會完整交接計畫
title.en: Full approved plan handed off when clearing context

body.zh-TW: 跟 Codex 敲定修改方案後，很多人會先清空脈絡重新開局，免得前面討論佔住記憶空間。現在點選 **Yes, clear context and implement**，Codex 會把整份已經核准的計畫完整交給新的工作階段。萬一交接失敗，原本的工作階段仍會保持開啟，不會當場關閉。⟦就跟銀行辦理舊戶結清轉存一樣，一定要確認完整金額已經入到新帳戶，行員才會把舊存摺剪角，要是中途轉帳失敗，原本的戶頭就會原封不動留著。⟧
body.en: After finalizing a plan with Codex, clearing context for a fresh start keeps earlier discussion from eating up memory. Now, selecting **Yes, clear context and implement** hands the full approved plan over to the fresh session. If the handoff fails, the current session stays open instead of closing on the spot. ⟦Like closing an old bank account to transfer the balance, the teller only cancels the old passbook after confirming the full amount has landed in the new account, leaving the original account untouched if the transfer fails midway.⟧

items.original: **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 沙盒路徑與目錄權限問題
title.en: Fix Windows sandbox path and directory permission handling

body.zh-TW: 用 Windows 沙盒跑指令，遇到帶引號的 `cmd.exe` 路徑，或是工作目錄上層無法讀取的 PowerShell 工作階段，過去沙盒處理會出狀況。這個問題已經修好，現在這兩種情況都能正常處理。
body.en: Running commands in the Windows sandbox previously broke on quoted `cmd.exe` paths or PowerShell sessions whose working directory had an unreadable parent. This has been fixed, and both cases now work properly.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)

title.zh-TW: macOS 貼上圖片保留方向與原生格式
title.en: Preserve orientation and native format for pasted macOS images

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 複製圖片直接貼進對話框，過去偶爾會碰到照片方向歪掉的困擾。現在貼上的圖片會保留原本預期的方向。只要剪貼簿裡有原生的 PNG 或 JPEG 資料，也會直接採用這些格式。
body.en: Copying and pasting an image directly into the chat box on macOS could occasionally leave the photo rotated the wrong way. Pasted images now retain their intended orientation. Whenever native PNG or JPEG data is available on the clipboard, those formats are used directly as well.

items.original: Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再卡在等待或被前輪中斷波及
title.en: Terminal no longer gets stuck waiting or hit by prior interruptions

body.zh-TW:
在終端機跑完或喊停一輪對話，最怕上一輪的等待或殘留訊號卡住接下來的新操作。

面對共用應用伺服器沒有回報的 MCP 伺服器，終端機現在不會再一直停在忙碌狀態苦等。

被打斷的對話回合也會乾淨收尾；就算前面遲來的中止訊號或檔案核准取消比較晚才到，也不會再打斷後面的回合。⟦有如攝影棚接連拍兩組客人，上一組提前收工就得把現場清乾淨，沒送到的器材或遲來的取消通知才不會打亂下一組開拍。⟧
body.en:
After finishing or stopping a conversation turn in the terminal, the last thing you want is waiting or leftover signals from the previous round blocking your next step.

When a shared app server does not report back on MCP servers, the terminal no longer stays stuck in a busy state waiting.

Interrupted turns also wrap up cleanly, so even a late abort signal or a delayed file approval cancellation will no longer cut off a later turn. ⟦Just as a photo studio shooting two clients back-to-back must clear the set when the first wraps early, undelivered gear or late cancellation notices will not disrupt the next shoot.⟧

items.original:
The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

title.zh-TW: openai-docs 技能聚焦團隊設定與上手
title.en: openai-docs skill focuses on team setup and onboarding

body.zh-TW: 剛上手想搞懂 Codex 與 ChatGPT Work，或是第一次串接 API（程式對接介面）不知從何起步，都可以直接找 `openai-docs` 技能幫忙。更新後的 `openai-docs` 把重心放在這兩項產品的疑問與首次 API 設定，還加入在團隊中統一配置 Codex 的專門指南。⟦像把綜合手冊換成城市專區摺頁一樣，第一次怎麼搭車、熱門疑問跟團體帶隊須知全集中在同一份裡。⟧
body.en: If you are just getting started with Codex and ChatGPT Work, or unsure where to begin with your first API (an interface for connecting programs) integration, you can turn straight to the `openai-docs` skill. The updated `openai-docs` focuses on questions about these two products and first-time API setup, and adds dedicated guidance for configuring Codex consistently across a team. ⟦Swapping a general handbook for a city-specific brochure puts first-time transit tips, popular questions, and group-leader notes all in one place.⟧

items.original: Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器客戶端補齊模型與閘道器文件
title.en: App-server clients get docs for models and gateways

body.zh-TW: 給正在開發串接程式的工程師：想針對個別已設定的供應商做操作，卻不想動到原本的預設選項，可以參考這次的說明。文件裡現在清楚說明，如何在不改動預設供應商的前提下，替已設定好的供應商列出模型，或是替它的閘道器完成授權。

title.zh-TW: 內建 SQLite 升級 3.54 納入日誌修復
title.en: Bundled SQLite upgraded to 3.54 with log fixes

body.zh-TW: Codex 背後靠內建的 SQLite 資料庫把資料存進本機，平時大多數人不會直接操作它。這次將內建的 SQLite 更新到 3.54 版，納入預寫式日誌（資料正式寫入前先留底的機制）的相關修復。⟦跟寄包裹前先把寄件單留底一樣，這次更新把這道預先記一筆的程序毛病修好，在背後平穩執行。⟧
body.en: Under the hood, Codex relies on a bundled SQLite database to store data locally, though most people never interact with it directly. This update upgrades bundled SQLite to version 3.54 and pulls in fixes for the write-ahead log (a mechanism that keeps a backup record before data is officially saved). ⟦Much like keeping a copy of the shipping slip before sending a package, this update fixes a glitch in that pre-recording step so it runs smoothly behind the scenes.⟧

items.original: Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集升級可沿用本機資料省下載
title.en: Plugin marketplace upgrades reuse local data to cut downloads

body.zh-TW: 在外掛市集進行升級，最煩的就是明明電腦裡已經存過很多檔案，卻還是得再從網路抓一次。現在外掛市集升級可以直接沿用硬碟上既有的 Git（版本控制工具）資料物件，減少重複下載。⟦拿拼樂高換新版造型來比喻，以前每次改版都整盒積木重新買一套，現在發現桶子裡本來就有的零件可以直接拿來組，不必全都重買。⟧
body.en: When upgrading in the plugin marketplace, few things are more annoying than having to download files all over again when plenty of them are already on your computer. Plugin marketplace upgrades can now reuse existing Git (a version control tool) objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. ⟦Take rebuilding a LEGO set into a new model: instead of buying a whole new box every time, you can use parts you already have in the bin and skip buying everything again.⟧

items.original: Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. (#60528)

first_title.zh-TW: 挑好新對話的模型供應商，舊對話依然照原設定跑
first_title.en: Pick a Model Provider for New Chats While Existing Ones Keep Theirs

entries: Added `accept-edits` mode to `--remote-agent` sessions: `Shift+Tab` now switches between the default mode and `accept-edits` instead of doing nothing. Sessions still start in the default mode, where the remote agent now asks before each file edit in its workspace, so you may see edit approval prompts you didn't get before; switch to `accept-edits` to let edits go ahead without asking.

Added the Orchestrator model to `/model` for Gemini Enterprise accounts and sign-ins with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`): it plans with Gemini 4 Carbon (High) and hands the plan's execution to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), and it appears when you can select both of those models.

Added a conversation navigator to the Remote Control browser view: a rail with a mark for each of your prompts previews the prompt when you hover over it and jumps to it when you click, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next prompt.
Added a `Quote` button to the Remote Control browser view: select text in an agent response and click `Quote` to add it to your next message as a quote.

Added clickable links to the message box and your sent messages in the Remote Control browser view: a web address you type or paste opens with `Cmd+click` (`Ctrl+click` on Windows and Linux) or a middle-click, while a plain click still places the cursor.

Added the time left to timers the agent sets, in the Remote Control browser view: each running timer in `Background Tasks` shows a countdown such as `59m left`, and when a timer is all that's running, the status line reads, for example, `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

Improved rate-limit handling: when the model API asks the CLI to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits and retries for delays of up to 4 minutes instead of stopping the turn when the delay is longer than 30 seconds, so per-minute rate and capacity limits no longer end your turn, while spend-cap, prepaid-balance, and weekly quota errors now stop the turn right away.

Improved `/model` when your plan offers more than one Orchestrator planner: the separate `Orchestrator (Carbon)` and `Orchestrator (Argon)` rows are now a single `Orchestrator` row with a `Planner` choice that you change with `←`/`→` or `Tab`, while `--model` and saved settings keep using the full names.

Improved switching to a conversation that's already open in long sessions: `/resume <id>` back to it and the switch after `/fork` no longer load the conversation's whole history first, so they no longer pause for a second or more, and `/btw` and `/help` side questions start faster too.

Improved memory use in long sessions: the CLI now keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when it needs them, instead of holding every step for as long as the conversation is open, and it no longer loads every earlier subagent's full history at the start of each turn, which could take several GiB in sessions that ran many subagents.

Improved click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: items you can click, such as `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt, now highlight when you hover over them.

Improved the side panel in the Remote Control browser view: files and reviews open in tabs that come back when you reload the page, and a new Overview Panel, opened from the title bar or with `Cmd+Option+O` (`Ctrl+Alt+O` on Windows and Linux), lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks.

Changed the terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/.config` (or your `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) and, on Windows, `AppData\Roaming` by default, since other programs keep settings and tokens there; previously they were readable. The settings of common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python stay readable, `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked, and you can still allow other paths explicitly in your sandbox rules.
Fixed Auto mode asking for approval to read files outside the workspace even when `Non-Workspace Access` is turned on in `/config`; Auto mode now honors that setting.

Fixed long, high-effort model responses being canceled and restarted from scratch when the model went more than 5 minutes without sending anything while it was still thinking; the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes before it treats a silent response as stalled.

Fixed turns failing with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or the conversation compacting far earlier than needed, after the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation's first compaction.

Fixed a rare race that could leave a new conversation unusable, with every message failing with `trajectory not found` even after a restart, when the conversation was created while the CLI was listing saved conversations, such as at startup or when an editor connected through `agy acp` refreshed its session list.

Fixed `agy acp` holding back what the agent did after a turn ended: when a background task or subagent finishes and wakes the agent, its replies, tool calls, and permission requests now reach the editor right away instead of at your next prompt, so the agent no longer waits on a permission request the editor never showed.

Fixed `agy acp` leaving a session's subagents and background tasks, such as dev servers, running after the editor canceled a prompt or closed the session, where they could keep working and wake the conversation again; canceling or closing now stops them, and closing does so even when no prompt is running.

Fixed signing in to a plugin right after installing it from `/plugin`, where pasting the code from its sign-in page could fail with "The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."

Fixed plugins running while your organization turns them off with `pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings: plugin MCP servers and other plugin processes no longer start before sign-in finishes, and they now stop as soon as an administrator turns plugins off during a session.

Fixed skills whose `SKILL.md` has no `name` in its frontmatter: they were all named `SKILL`, so only the first one loaded and the rest were silently dropped; each is now named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

Fixed the agent writing LF line endings when it appends to a file that uses CRLF line endings, as is common on Windows, which left the file with mixed line endings and made later multi-line edits to it fail with `target content not found`; appended text now uses the file's own line endings.

Fixed OSC 7501 terminal status showing the session as done while the agent was paused waiting for background subagents or tasks to finish; the terminal's tab or window now shows it as working until that work ends, and daemon tasks such as dev servers don't count.

Fixed typing in the Remote Control browser view: with Chrome on Android, `Backspace` on the on-screen keyboard could stop deleting characters and later text could land in the middle of a word, and after typing with an input method or a phone keyboard's suggestions, `Enter` could add a new line instead of sending your message.
Fixed scrolling up through a long agent turn in the Remote Control browser view, where the view could jump back down instead of reaching your prompt.

Fixed the permission prompt in the Remote Control browser view letting the number or arrow keys select and submit an unavailable "always allow" option when one of your ask rules or a hook requires you to confirm each time; the keyboard now skips those options, as clicking already did.

Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view switching to `No Model Selected` after a brief connection or server error; it now keeps your account and model list until the next successful refresh.

title.zh-TW: --remote-agent 新增編輯自動放行模式
title.en: --remote-agent adds accept-edits mode

body.zh-TW:
開啟遠端代理工作階段後，現在每改動工作區裡的檔案前都會跳出詢問，跟以前直接改完不太一樣。覺得逐一確認太繁瑣，按 `Shift+Tab` 就能在預設模式與 `accept-edits` 模式之間切換，不再沒反應。

新開啟的工作階段依然從預設模式開始，切到 `accept-edits` 後，代理改檔案就會直接進行、不再每次發問。⟦交給剪輯師修影片時，預設改成他每剪一刀都先給你看過才動手；確認方向對了，再切到直接放行模式讓他順順改下去。⟧
body.en:
After starting a remote agent session, it now prompts before changing any file in the workspace, unlike before when it edited directly. If confirming each change feels tedious, pressing `Shift+Tab` toggles between the default mode and `accept-edits` mode instead of doing nothing.

New sessions still start in the default mode, and switching to `accept-edits` lets the agent edit files directly without asking each time. ⟦When handing a video to a film editor, the default now has them check with you before every cut; once you are sure the direction is right, switch to direct approval mode so they can keep editing smoothly.⟧

items.original: Added `accept-edits` mode to `--remote-agent` sessions: `Shift+Tab` now switches between the default mode and `accept-edits` instead of doing nothing. Sessions still start in the default mode, where the remote agent now asks before each file edit in its workspace, so you may see edit approval prompts you didn't get before; switch to `accept-edits` to let edits go ahead without asking.

title.zh-TW: /model 新增 Orchestrator 模型
title.en: /model adds the Orchestrator model

body.zh-TW:
以 Gemini Enterprise 帳號或 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 應用程式預設憑證登入，若帳號能選取 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 這兩個模型，`/model` 就會出現 `Orchestrator`。它會先讓 Gemini 4 Carbon (High) 擬定計畫。接著交由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High) 接手執行。

方案若含多種規劃者，`Orchestrator (Carbon)` 會整併進單一 `Orchestrator` 列。另一列 `Orchestrator (Argon)` 也收進來，可用 `←`、`→` 或 `Tab` 切換 `Planner`。至於 `--model` 指令參數與已存設定，仍使用原本的完整名稱。⟦裝潢房子時，一位建築師先畫好整套藍圖，再交給工班主任按圖施工，你也能在同一窗口直接指定建築師。⟧
body.en:
When signed in with a Gemini Enterprise account or `AGY_ADC_AUTH` Application Default Credentials, `Orchestrator` appears in `/model` if your account can select both Carbon and Hydrogen. It first has Gemini 4 Carbon (High) draft a plan. Then it hands execution off to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High).

If your plan includes multiple planners, `Orchestrator (Carbon)` is merged into a single `Orchestrator` row. The `Orchestrator (Argon)` row is folded in too, and you can switch `Planner` using `←`, `→`, or `Tab`. Meanwhile, `--model` flags and saved settings still use the original full names. ⟦During a home renovation, one architect draws up the full blueprint and then hands it to a site foreman to build from, and you can pick the architect right from the same contact.⟧

items.original:
Added the Orchestrator model to `/model` for Gemini Enterprise accounts and sign-ins with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`): it plans with Gemini 4 Carbon (High) and hands the plan's execution to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), and it appears when you can select both of those models.
Improved `/model` when your plan offers more than one Orchestrator planner: the separate `Orchestrator (Carbon)` and `Orchestrator (Argon)` rows are now a single `Orchestrator` row with a `Planner` choice that you change with `←`/`→` or `Tab`, while `--model` and saved settings keep using the full names.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁新增對話導覽軌道
title.en: Remote Control browser view adds conversation navigator rail

body.zh-TW:
在長對話裡來回翻找先前的指令，滑鼠滾輪常要捲老半天。遠端控制網頁版新增了對話導覽軌道，你送出的每則提問都會在軌道上留下一道標記。

把游標停在標記上就能預覽該則提問，點一下直接跳過去；習慣用鍵盤的話，按 `[` 或 `]` 也能跳到上一則或下一則提問。⟦聽長篇廣播節目時，以前想找前面某段得一路盲拉進度條，現在軸線上直接標出每個段落，停上去預覽、點一下就能直達。⟧
body.en:
Scrolling back through a long conversation to find earlier prompts often takes ages with a mouse wheel. The Remote Control browser view now includes a conversation navigator rail that leaves a mark on the track for every prompt you send.

Hover over a mark to preview that prompt and click to jump straight to it; if you prefer the keyboard, press `[` or `]` to jump to the previous or next prompt. ⟦Listening to a long radio show used to mean blindly dragging the progress bar to find an earlier segment, whereas now every segment is marked right on the timeline so you can hover to preview and click to jump straight there.⟧

items.original: Added a conversation navigator to the Remote Control browser view: a rail with a mark for each of your prompts previews the prompt when you hover over it and jumps to it when you click, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next prompt.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁新增 Quote 引用按鈕
title.en: Remote Control browser view adds Quote button

body.zh-TW: 想針對代理長篇回覆裡的某一段繼續追問，現在不必自己手動複製再整理。在遠端控制網頁版選取代理回覆中的任意文字，點擊 `Quote` 按鈕，這段話就會以引用格式放進你的下一則訊息。
body.en: When you want to follow up on one part of a long agent response, you no longer have to copy and format it by hand. Select any text in an agent response in the Remote Control browser view and click the `Quote` button to insert that passage as a quote into your next message.

items.original: Added a `Quote` button to the Remote Control browser view: select text in an agent response and click `Quote` to add it to your next message as a quote.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁的網址可按鍵直接開啟
title.en: Links in Remote Control browser view open directly on click

body.zh-TW:
訊息裡貼了網址想順手點開，過去還得反白複製到新分頁。輸入框裡打好的網址，以及你已送出的訊息裡的網址，現在都能直接點開。

在 Mac 按 `Cmd+click`、Windows 與 Linux 按 `Ctrl+click`，或按滑鼠中鍵就能開啟連結，單純左鍵點擊依然只會放置游標。
body.en:
Opening a URL pasted into a message used to mean highlighting it and copying it into a new tab. Web addresses typed in the message box and those in your sent messages can now be opened directly.

On Mac, use `Cmd+click`, on Windows and Linux use `Ctrl+click`, or middle-click to open the link, while a plain left-click still just places the cursor.

items.original: Added clickable links to the message box and your sent messages in the Remote Control browser view: a web address you type or paste opens with `Cmd+click` (`Ctrl+click` on Windows and Linux) or a middle-click, while a plain click still places the cursor.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁計時器顯示剩餘倒數
title.en: Timers show remaining countdown in Remote Control browser view

body.zh-TW:
代理在背景設定計時器後，你不用自己推算還要等多久。遠端控制網頁版的 `Background Tasks` 清單裡，每個運作中的計時器都會顯示像 `59m left` 這樣的剩餘倒數。

若是當下只有計時器在跑，狀態列也會跟著顯示例如 `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left` 的進度。
body.en:
Once the agent sets a timer in the background, you no longer have to calculate how much longer to wait. In the Remote Control browser view's `Background Tasks` list, each running timer shows a remaining countdown like `59m left`.

If a timer is the only thing running at that moment, the status line also shows progress such as `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

items.original: Added the time left to timers the agent sets, in the Remote Control browser view: each running timer in `Background Tasks` shows a countdown such as `59m left`, and when a timer is all that's running, the status line reads, for example, `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁側邊欄保留分頁並增設總覽
title.en: Remote Control browser view side panel keeps tabs and adds Overview

body.zh-TW:
遠端控制網頁版把頁面重整後，原本打開的檔案或檢視畫面不再跟著消失。側邊欄裡開啟的檔案與檢視內容現在會以分頁保留，重新整理網頁後照樣會恢復。

側邊欄也新增了 Overview Panel，可從標題列點開，或按 `Cmd+Option+O` 叫出。Windows 與 Linux 快捷鍵則是 `Ctrl+Alt+O`，裡面會列出對話的產物、修改過的檔案、子代理與背景任務。⟦辦活動時，以前重整場地就把各組資料夾全收掉，現在攤開的分頁都留在原位，旁邊還多了張總表一次看清誰在忙什麼。⟧
body.en:
Reloading the Remote Control browser view no longer wipes out the files or reviews you had open. Files and views opened in the side panel are now kept as tabs and are restored after a page reload.

The side panel also adds an Overview Panel, which you can open from the title bar or by pressing `Cmd+Option+O`. On Windows and Linux, the shortcut is `Ctrl+Alt+O`, and it lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks. ⟦Think of running an event: tidying up the venue used to mean packing away every team's folder, whereas now the open tabs stay right where they are, with a summary sheet beside them showing who is working on what at a glance.⟧

items.original: Improved the side panel in the Remote Control browser view: files and reviews open in tabs that come back when you reload the page, and a new Overview Panel, opened from the title bar or with `Cmd+Option+O` (`Ctrl+Alt+O` on Windows and Linux), lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks.

title.zh-TW: 限流等待重試上限放寬至 4 分鐘
title.en: Rate-limit retry wait raised to 4 minutes

body.zh-TW:
模型暫時塞車，這一輪對話不會動不動就被迫中斷。當模型介面要求稍候再試，指令列工具現在會等到最多 4 分鐘並自動重試，不再像過去只要等待超過 30 秒就直接結束這一輪。

因此每分鐘頻率限制與容量上限不會再打斷你的進度；不過一旦遇到消費上限、預付餘額不足或每週額度用盡的錯誤，則會立刻停止該輪。⟦排熱門餐廳一樣，以前等超過半分鐘沒位子就直接走人，現在只要還會翻桌就願意多等一會；但要是折價券或額度用光，就立刻改天再來。⟧
body.en:
Temporary model congestion no longer cuts your turn short so easily. When the model API asks to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits up to 4 minutes and retries automatically, instead of ending the turn as soon as the wait exceeded 30 seconds.

As a result, per-minute rate limits and capacity limits no longer interrupt your progress; however, spend-cap, insufficient prepaid-balance, or weekly quota exhaustion errors will stop the turn right away. ⟦Picture waiting in line at a popular restaurant: you used to walk away if there was no table within half a minute, and now you are willing to wait a bit longer as long as tables are turning over, though if your vouchers or balance run out, you immediately come back another day.⟧

items.original: Improved rate-limit handling: when the model API asks the CLI to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits and retries for delays of up to 4 minutes instead of stopping the turn when the delay is longer than 30 seconds, so per-minute rate and capacity limits no longer end your turn, while spend-cap, prepaid-balance, and weekly quota errors now stop the turn right away.

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段切換對話更快也更省記憶體
title.en: Faster conversation switching and lower memory use in long sessions

body.zh-TW:
對話開久了之後來回切換，常會卡頓又佔記憶體。現在用 `/resume <id>` 切回已開啟的對話，或用 `/fork` 分岔後切換，都不再先把整份歷史載入，因此不再停頓一秒以上。`/btw` 和 `/help` 這類旁白提問也啟動得更快。

記憶體管理也跟著調整：工作階段開啟期間，指令列工具只保留最近用到的對話步驟，舊步驟等需要時再從硬碟重讀。每輪開始時也不再載入先前所有子代理的完整紀錄，跑過大量子代理時原本可能吃掉數 GiB 的空間。⟦在廚房備料時，以前把整週食材全攤在流理台差點沒位子切菜，現在只留當下要用的，其餘先收進儲藏室隨用隨拿。⟧
body.en:
Switching back and forth in long-running conversations often lags and eats up memory. Now, switching back to an open conversation with `/resume <id>` or switching after `/fork` no longer loads the entire history first, eliminating pauses of a second or more. Side questions like `/btw` and `/help` also start faster.

Memory management has been adjusted as well: while a session is open, the CLI keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when needed. It also no longer loads the full history of all previous subagents at the start of each turn, which could otherwise consume several GiB when many subagents had run. ⟦Prepping ingredients in a kitchen used to mean spreading a whole week's groceries across the counter until there was barely room to chop, whereas now only what you need right away stays out and the rest waits in the pantry to be grabbed on demand.⟧

items.original:
Improved switching to a conversation that's already open in long sessions: `/resume <id>` back to it and the switch after `/fork` no longer load the conversation's whole history first, so they no longer pause for a second or more, and `/btw` and `/help` side questions start faster too.
Improved memory use in long sessions: the CLI now keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when it needs them, instead of holding every step for as long as the conversation is open, and it no longer loads every earlier subagent's full history at the start of each turn, which could take several GiB in sessions that ran many subagents.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式可點擊項目懸停會發亮
title.en: Clickable items highlight on hover in full screen mode

body.zh-TW:
使用 `full screen (altscreen)` 全螢幕模式，游標移過去常分不清哪裡能點開。現在只要把游標停在可點擊的項目上，畫面就會高亮標示。

這些項目包含 `(ctrl+o to expand)` 展開提示、思考內容、展開後的工具群組，以及釘選在畫面的提問。
body.en:
In `full screen (altscreen)` mode, it was often hard to tell what could be clicked when moving the cursor around. Now, hovering over any clickable item highlights it on screen.

These items include `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt.

items.original: Improved click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: items you can click, such as `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt, now highlight when you hover over them.

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒預設封鎖讀取設定目錄
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Blocks Reading Config Directories by Default

body.zh-TW:
許多軟體會把帳號設定與 token（授權令牌）存在系統資料夾，過去受限指令也能直接查看。現在終端機沙盒預設會擋下 `~/.config` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`，在 Windows 也會擋下 `AppData\Roaming`。

不過 Git、Go、npm 與 Python 等常見開發工具的設定依然可以讀取，而 `~/.git-credentials` 則改為預設封鎖。如果確實需要讓指令讀取其他路徑，你還是能在沙盒規則裡明確放行。⟦請人來家裡修家電時，以前連臥室抽屜都沒關任他查看，現在先把放存摺和印章的抽屜鎖好，只留維修需要的工具箱。⟧
body.en:
Many programs store account settings and tokens (authentication credentials) in system folders, which restricted commands could previously read directly. Now, the terminal sandbox blocks `~/.config` or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` by default, and also blocks `AppData\Roaming` on Windows.

However, settings for common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python remain readable, while `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked by default. If you genuinely need a command to read other paths, you can still allow them explicitly in your sandbox rules. ⟦Inviting a technician to repair an appliance at home used to mean leaving bedroom drawers open for them to look through; now you lock the drawer holding your bankbook and stamps first, leaving out only the toolbox needed for the repair.⟧

items.original: Changed the terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/.config` (or your `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) and, on Windows, `AppData\Roaming` by default, since other programs keep settings and tokens there; previously they were readable. The settings of common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python stay readable, `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked, and you can still allow other paths explicitly in your sandbox rules.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Auto 模式忽略工作區外存取設定
title.en: Fix Auto Mode Ignoring Non-Workspace Access Setting

body.zh-TW: 明明已在 `/config` 開啟 `Non-Workspace Access`，讓工具讀取工作區以外的檔案，以前在 Auto 模式下卻還是會跳出核准詢問。這個問題已經修好，Auto 模式現在會依照這項設定放行。
body.en: Even when `Non-Workspace Access` was turned on in `/config` so tools could read files outside the workspace, Auto mode still prompted for approval. This issue is fixed, and Auto mode now honors that setting.

items.original: Fixed Auto mode asking for approval to read files outside the workspace even when `Non-Workspace Access` is turned on in `/config`; Auto mode now honors that setting.

title.zh-TW: 高思考強度長回覆靜默上限延至 10 分鐘
title.en: Extend Silent Timeout to 10 Minutes for High-Effort Responses

body.zh-TW: 請模型進行高思考強度的長篇處理時，以前只要它在思考過程中超過 5 分鐘沒有回傳任何內容，就會被判定卡住而整段取消重來。這個問題已經修好，指令列工具現在最多會等待 10 分鐘。
body.en: When asking the model for long, high-effort processing, any pause of more than 5 minutes without returning content while thinking previously caused it to be treated as stalled and canceled from scratch. This issue is fixed, and the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes.

items.original: Fixed long, high-effort model responses being canceled and restarted from scratch when the model went more than 5 minutes without sending anything while it was still thinking; the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes before it treats a silent response as stalled.

title.zh-TW: 修正讀取超大檔案後報錯或過早壓縮
title.en: Fix Errors or Early Compaction After Reading Large Files

body.zh-TW: 對話還沒壓縮過，就讓代理讀取動輒好幾 MB 的 PDF 等超大檔案，過去很容易出狀況。這一輪可能會報錯 `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`，或是遠早於需要時就提前壓縮，現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: If the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation was compacted, things could easily go wrong. That turn could fail with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or compact far earlier than needed, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed turns failing with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or the conversation compacting far earlier than needed, after the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation's first compaction.

title.zh-TW: 修正特定時機新建對話失效問題
title.en: Fix New Conversations Failing at Specific Timing

body.zh-TW: 指令列工具剛啟動，或透過 `agy acp` 連線的編輯器正在重整已存工作階段清單的瞬間建立新對話，過去偶爾會發生順序衝突。這會讓新對話每則訊息都報錯 `trajectory not found`，連重開都救不回，現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: Starting a new conversation right as the CLI launched or while an editor connected through `agy acp` was refreshing its saved session list could occasionally hit a race condition. That left every message in the new conversation failing with `trajectory not found`, unrecoverable even after a restart, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed a rare race that could leave a new conversation unusable, with every message failing with `trajectory not found` even after a restart, when the conversation was created while the CLI was listing saved conversations, such as at startup or when an editor connected through `agy acp` refreshed its session list.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy acp 背景任務回報與停止時機
title.en: Fix agy acp Background Task Reporting and Stop Timing

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把代理接進編輯器後，該輪結束時若背景任務或子代理完成並喚醒代理，過去回覆、工具呼叫和權限請求會被扣住，等到你送出下一句才看得到。現在這些訊息會即時送到編輯器，代理不再卡在編輯器根本沒顯示的權限詢問上。

當編輯器取消提示詞或關閉工作階段後，屬於該工作階段的子代理與開發伺服器等背景任務，過去會繼續留在背景運作、甚至重新喚醒對話。現在取消或關閉都會把它們停下來，而且關閉工作階段時，就算沒有提示詞在執行也照樣停止。
body.en:
After connecting the agent to an editor via `agy acp`, if a background task or subagent finished after a turn ended and woke the agent, replies, tool calls, and permission requests were previously held back until you sent your next message. Now those messages reach the editor right away, so the agent no longer stalls on a permission prompt the editor never showed.

Previously, when the editor canceled a prompt or closed a session, subagents and background tasks belonging to that session, such as dev servers, kept running in the background and could even wake the conversation again. Now canceling or closing stops them, and closing a session stops them even when no prompt is running.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` holding back what the agent did after a turn ended: when a background task or subagent finishes and wakes the agent, its replies, tool calls, and permission requests now reach the editor right away instead of at your next prompt, so the agent no longer waits on a permission request the editor never showed.
Fixed `agy acp` leaving a session's subagents and background tasks, such as dev servers, running after the editor canceled a prompt or closed the session, where they could keep working and wake the conversation again; canceling or closing now stops them, and closing does so even when no prompt is running.

title.zh-TW: 外掛啟停登入與技能命名修復
title.en: Fix Plugin Sign-In, Admin Toggling, and Skill Naming

body.zh-TW:
從 `/plugin` 裝完外掛立刻登入並貼上代碼，過去可能會失敗。畫面會顯示 `"The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."`。這個登入問題現在已經修好。

若管理員在受管設定以 `pluginsDisabled` 停用外掛，外掛的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與程序不會再於登入前啟動。工作階段途中一旦被管理員關閉，它們也會立刻停止。

當技能的 `SKILL.md` 開頭欄位沒寫 `name`，過去全都叫 `SKILL`，只載入第一個而略過其餘。現在會改用所屬資料夾命名，`agy plugin validate` 也會回報該名稱。
body.en:
Signing in and pasting the code right after installing a plugin from `/plugin` could previously fail. The screen displayed `"The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."`. This sign-in issue is now fixed.

When an administrator disables plugins in managed settings using `pluginsDisabled`, plugin MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers and processes no longer start before sign-in. If an administrator turns them off mid-session, they also stop immediately.

When a skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter omitted `name`, all of them were previously named `SKILL`, so only the first loaded and the rest were skipped. Now each is named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

items.original:
Fixed signing in to a plugin right after installing it from `/plugin`, where pasting the code from its sign-in page could fail with "The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."
Fixed plugins running while your organization turns them off with `pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings: plugin MCP servers and other plugin processes no longer start before sign-in finishes, and they now stop as soon as an administrator turns plugins off during a session.
Fixed skills whose `SKILL.md` has no `name` in its frontmatter: they were all named `SKILL`, so only the first one loaded and the rest were silently dropped; each is now named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

title.zh-TW: 修正尾端追加文字混雜換行格式錯誤
title.en: Fix Mixed Line Endings When Appending to Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 開啟慣用 CRLF 結尾的檔案並從最後一行接續寫入，代理以前會寫成 LF。這會讓同一份檔案夾雜兩種斷行，後續多行修改就會跳出 `target content not found`。這個問題已經修好，現在追加的文字會沿用檔案原本的換行格式。
body.en: On Windows, when opening a file that uses CRLF endings and appending to the last line, the agent previously wrote LF. That left the file with mixed line endings, causing later multi-line edits to fail with `target content not found`. This issue is fixed, and appended text now uses the file's original line endings.

items.original: Fixed the agent writing LF line endings when it appends to a file that uses CRLF line endings, as is common on Windows, which left the file with mixed line endings and made later multi-line edits to it fail with `target content not found`; appended text now uses the file's own line endings.

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機等待背景工作時誤顯完成
title.en: Fix Terminal Showing Done While Waiting on Background Work

body.zh-TW: 你把子代理或任務放去背後跑、代理正停下來等結果，以前 OSC 7501 狀態列會先把這個工作階段標示為結束。這個問題已經修好，現在分頁或視窗會保持在執行中直到工作完成，不過像開發伺服器這類常駐任務不計算在內。
body.en: When you sent a subagent or task to the background and the agent paused to wait for results, the OSC 7501 status bar previously marked the session as done. This issue is fixed, so the tab or window now stays in the working state until that work finishes, though daemon tasks such as dev servers do not count.

items.original: Fixed OSC 7501 terminal status showing the session as done while the agent was paused waiting for background subagents or tasks to finish; the terminal's tab or window now shows it as working until that work ends, and daemon tasks such as dev servers don't count.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁操作與選單問題修復
title.en: Fix Remote Control Browser Input and Menu Issues

body.zh-TW:
用手機或電腦瀏覽器連回來發訊息、滑動長對話或挑選項時，畫面原本有幾處會卡住或亂跳。

在 Android 的 Chrome 用螢幕鍵盤打字時，`Backspace` 不再突然刪不動、後續文字也不會插進單字中間。使用輸入法或手機選字建議後按 `Enter`，會直接送出訊息而不是換行。

代理回覆特別長時，往上捲動想回到自己的提問，畫面不會再莫名跳回底下。

若你設定了 `ask` 規則或 hook（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）要求每次確認，權限提示裡不可用的「一律允許」選項，現在用數字鍵或方向鍵也會跳過，跟滑鼠點擊一樣。

連線或伺服器短暫出錯時，模型選單不會再跳成 `No Model Selected`，而是保留你原本的帳號與模型清單直到下次更新成功。
body.en:
When connecting from a phone or desktop browser to send messages, scroll through long conversations, or pick options, several parts of the interface could previously freeze or jump.

When typing with the on-screen keyboard in Chrome on Android, `Backspace` no longer stops deleting characters, and subsequent text no longer lands in the middle of a word. Pressing `Enter` after using an input method or phone keyboard suggestions now sends the message instead of adding a new line.

When the agent's reply is especially long, scrolling up to return to your own prompt no longer unexpectedly jumps back to the bottom.

If you configured an `ask` rule or a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) requiring confirmation each time, the unavailable "always allow" option in the permission prompt is now skipped by number and arrow keys, matching mouse clicks.

During a brief connection or server error, the model menu no longer switches to `No Model Selected`, keeping your existing account and model list until the next successful refresh.

items.original:
Fixed typing in the Remote Control browser view: with Chrome on Android, `Backspace` on the on-screen keyboard could stop deleting characters and later text could land in the middle of a word, and after typing with an input method or a phone keyboard's suggestions, `Enter` could add a new line instead of sending your message.
Fixed scrolling up through a long agent turn in the Remote Control browser view, where the view could jump back down instead of reaching your prompt.
Fixed the permission prompt in the Remote Control browser view letting the number or arrow keys select and submit an unavailable "always allow" option when one of your ask rules or a hook requires you to confirm each time; the keyboard now skips those options, as clicking already did.
Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view switching to `No Model Selected` after a brief connection or server error; it now keeps your account and model list until the next successful refresh.

first_title.en: Added run_workflow to dispatch multi-agent workflows

title.zh-TW: 未辨識終端機支援 Shift+Enter 換行
title.en: Unidentified terminals support Shift+Enter newlines

body.zh-TW:
寫長段落想另起一行卻插不進去，往往是因為手邊的命令列視窗還沒被認出來。現在只要在設定檔加入這段設定，`Shift+Enter` 就能照常換行：

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

⟦替沒貼型號標籤的電器接上插座，以前清單裡找不到名字就不通電，現在只要先確認相容性就能正常運作。⟧
body.en:
Trying to start a new line in a long paragraph often failed because your terminal window wasn't recognized yet. Adding this setting to your config file now lets `Shift+Enter` insert newlines as usual:

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

⟦Think of plugging in an unlabeled appliance: it used to get no power when its name was missing from the list, and now checking compatibility first lets it run normally.⟧

items.original: `[ui] kitty_keyboard = "query"` lets Shift+Enter insert newlines in unidentified terminals

title.zh-TW: 工作階段重載或更新不再無故重啟 MCP 連線
title.en: Session reloads or updates no longer restart MCP connections unnecessarily

body.zh-TW: 你把手邊的工作階段重新讀取或刷新內容，外部工具以前常跟著白白斷開又連回。現在重新載入或更新工作階段，MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器連線不會再發生這種多餘的重啟。⟦就像整理辦公桌上的記事本，以前只是翻頁重看，桌上的檯燈也得跟著關掉重開，現在只翻本子，燈會安穩亮著。⟧
body.en: When you reloaded or refreshed your current session, external tools used to disconnect and reconnect for no reason. Now when you reload or update a session, MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) server connections no longer go through these unnecessary restarts. ⟦When organizing a notebook on your desk, simply flipping back to reread a page used to switch the desk lamp off and on again; now only the pages turn while the lamp stays steadily lit.⟧

items.original: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

title.zh-TW: 複製內容與畫面互動不再出錯
title.en: Copying content and screen interactions no longer fail

body.zh-TW:
在對話介面複製連結、雙擊文字或按快捷鍵，過去偶爾會遇到畫面反應不如預期。

使用引言複製含有連結的內容，連結裡的 `&` 符號現在會保留下來，不再被吃掉。

畫面上缺少文字時，雙擊原本會把思考過程摺疊起來，現在不會再這麼做。

`Ctrl+L` 現在能在更多畫面上直接使用。

畫面上顯示的複製提示，現在也會和實際進到剪貼簿的內容一致。

⟦像拿著透明描圖紙抄資料，以前邊角總會漏掉幾筆、多點一下還把整頁折起來，現在描下來的跟底稿一模一樣，按鈕也處處順手。⟧
body.en:
When copying links, double-clicking text, or pressing shortcuts in the chat interface, the screen occasionally reacted unexpectedly.

When using quote copy on content containing links, `&` characters in those links are now preserved instead of being stripped.

When text is missing on screen, double-clicking used to fold thoughts, and it no longer does.

`Ctrl+L` now works directly on more screens.

Copy hints shown on screen now match what actually copies to the clipboard.

⟦Picture copying notes with transparent tracing paper: corners used to miss a few strokes and an extra tap folded the whole page, whereas now the tracing matches the original and every button responds smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Quote copy now preserves `&` in links, and double-clicks no longer fold thoughts when missing text
`Ctrl+L` now works on more screens, and copy hints match what actually copies to the clipboard

title.zh-TW: 回溯後底部上下文用量不再歸零或過時
title.en: Footer context usage no longer resets to zero or stays stale after a rewind

body.zh-TW: 用回溯功能退回前面的對話進度，以前經常看到畫面底部顯示的容量突然掉到零，或是還停在退回前的舊數字。這個問題已經修好，現在回溯後，畫面底部的上下文（AI 目前載入的對話與資料量）用量會跟著更新，不再歸零或停在過時數值。
body.en: When using rewind to step back to an earlier point in a conversation, the capacity shown at the bottom of the screen often dropped to zero or stayed stuck on the old number from before the rewind. This issue is fixed: after a rewind, the context (the amount of conversation and data currently loaded by the AI) usage in the footer now updates accordingly instead of dropping to zero or showing stale values.

items.original: Context usage shown in the footer no longer drops to zero or shows stale values after a rewind

title.zh-TW: /resume 清單展開收合與工作階段內一致
title.en: /resume list expand and collapse matches in-session behavior

body.zh-TW: 翻找先前的舊對話準備接續往下聊，在列表裡點開或收起每一列，過去的操作反應總覺得跟實際進到對話後不太一樣。現在 `/resume` 清單的每一列，展開和收合都改成與工作階段內相同。
body.en: When browsing earlier conversations to pick up where you left off, expanding or collapsing each row in the list used to feel different from how it behaved inside an actual conversation. Now each row in the `/resume` list expands and collapses the same way it does inside a session.

items.original: Rows in the `/resume` list now expand and collapse the same way they do inside a session

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷
title.en: Models that cannot view images no longer break when reading images

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告
title.en: Agent sessions in editors warn when they can no longer be saved

body.zh-TW: 你跟 AI 互動到一半，如果這段紀錄沒辦法繼續存下來，以前不會收到任何提示。現在只要工作階段無法再存檔，編輯器就會發出警告。
body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: muse exec 的 JSON 附圖也會加編號
title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.zh-TW: 過去執行 `muse exec --json --image` 帶入圖片，提示詞裡不會幫圖片加上編號。現在它會比照不加 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image`，在提示裡為每張附圖標上 `[Image #N]`。
body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.
